title: D. Please solve this in O(N^3)

legend: You are given an undirected graph with N$$$N$$$ nodes and M$$$M$$$ edges. Each node is assigned a bitmask A$$$A$$$ (where 1≤A≤230−1$$$1 \leq A \leq 2^{30} - 1$$$). Your task is to determine, for every node i$$$i$$$, which nodes j$$$j$$$ are reachable from i$$$i$$$ via some valid path. Output an N×N$$$N \times N$$$ matrix of characters, where the j$$$j$$$th character in the i$$$i$$$th row is '1' if there exists at least one valid path from node i$$$i$$$ to node j$$$j$$$, and '0' otherwise.
